summary: Makes Weather schedules persona-agnostic, gives clean installs one neutral unvoiced all-day persona, removes literal-day fallbacks and KanDrive's fixed-slot/Kokoro-only restrictions, corrects active Weather/Web Requests terminology, and adds the speech-text audit. Existing configuration is never rewritten. Help-text-only additive migrations; no dependency, unit, static, nginx, protected-runtime, or live cutover change.
